name: Find link gap prospects from competitor backlinks with DataForSEO, OpenAI and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Who links to all of your competitors and not to you

Fill in your domain and two or three competitors. The domains that link to every one of them and to none of yours land in your outreach sheet, scored, each with the page of yours worth pitching to it.

### How it works

**`Find Who Links To Them All`** is a true intersection: semrush.com plus ahrefs.com shared 13,612 referring domains, and adding moz.com cut that to 9,773. Every row has linked to every competitor you named.

Your own domain goes in `exclude_targets`, which is what turns the list into a gap: excluding moz.com from that same intersection took it to 3,756.

**Sorting is not optional.** Unsorted, the top row was an alternate-tag farm with 409,843 backlinks from 2 referring domains, so the request orders by domain rank and filters on spam score.

**`Check They Are Alive`** measures the whole shortlist in one request. Domain rank says nothing about readers, and a dead site with a good rank is a wasted email.

**`Find Your Best Pages`** runs beside the prospect search, so the angle names a page of yours that already earns traffic. Any page the model returns that is not on that list is dropped, and so is any prospect nobody could email - google.com is in this intersection, at rank 273.

### Setup

1. A DataForSEO account as an n8n **Basic Auth** credential - login is your email, password is the API password.

2. A Google Sheet with a tab called `prospects` and the header row `found_on`, `for_domain`, `domain`, `score`, `domain_rank`, `monthly_visits`, `spam_score`, `links_to_rivals`, `first_linked`, `pitch_page`, `angle`, `status`.

3. A Google Sheets credential and an OpenAI credential.

4. Open the form URL and fill it in. Three competitors is usually the sweet spot; four narrows the intersection to almost nothing.

## 1. Ask for the gap
Your domain, two or three competitors, and the sheet the answer should land in. Nothing else is stored.

## 2. Two questions at once
Who links to all of them, and which of your pages already earn traffic. Neither needs the other, so neither waits.

## 3. Wait for both, then decide
A narrow filter legitimately matches nothing. That is a page explaining why, not an empty sheet.

## 4. Rank is not readership
One request measures the whole shortlist. A high-rank domain nobody reads scores below a smaller one that people do.

## 5. What to pitch, and why
The model picks from your real pages. Anything it returns that is not on that list is dropped rather than sent.

## 6. Into the sheet, back to the browser
The rows and the summary are built side by side. A Sheets append emits the row it wrote, not the data it was given.

## Name competitors, not aggregators

Put a directory or a giant like `wikipedia.org` in the competitor list and you intersect your prospects with everybody who links to Wikipedia, which is everybody. Use domains that sell what you sell.

parameters.formDescription: Domains that link to every one of your competitors and not to you, scored, each with the page of yours worth pitching to it. They land in your sheet. Takes about a minute.

nodes.name: Find Who Links To Them All

parameters.text:
=You are a link outreach strategist for {{ $json.you }}.

Every domain below already links to all of these competitors:
{{ $json.rivals.join(', ') }}. None of them links to {{ $json.you }}.

PROSPECTS:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.for_model, null, 1) }}

PAGES ON {{ $json.you }} WORTH PITCHING, with estimated monthly traffic:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.your_pages, null, 1) }}

Return one object per prospect with exactly these keys:
  "domain" - copied from the prospect exactly
  "pitch_page" - one URL copied exactly from the page list, or "" if none fits
  "angle" - one sentence under 25 words saying why that page belongs on that site

Return a JSON array and nothing else. No markdown fence, no commentary.
Never invent a page URL. If no page from the list fits, use an empty string.

parameters.responseText:
=

No new prospects

{{ $json.total_found }} domains link to every competitor you named. None of them cleared a domain rank above {{ $json.min_rank }} with an acceptable spam score.

Two things usually cause an empty answer: an intersection of four or five competitors is nearly empty by construction, and a minimum rank above 300 removes most real sites. Try two competitors and a minimum rank of 100.
